sourceNotes.supportedDtypes: Intel Architecture Instruction Set Extensions Programming Reference documents AMX-BF16 and AMX-INT8 as separate ISA extensions introduced with Sapphire Rapids. FP32 is not a supported AMX tile dtype; FP32 is produced as an accumulator result type only.
sourceNotes.accumulationDtypes: TDPBF16PS instruction accumulates BF16 tiles into FP32. TDPBSSD/TDPBSUD/TDPBUSD/TDPBUUD instructions accumulate INT8 tiles into INT32, which is then usable as FP32 via reinterpret or convert. Source: Intel ISA reference.
sourceNotes.requiredKAlignment: AMX tile configuration: INT8 VNNI packs 4 bytes per inner-product element across 8 columns, requiring K divisible by 32. Source: Intel AMX Programming Model documentation.
sourceNotes.requiredNAlignment: AMX tile dimensions require N divisible by 16 for BF16 and INT8. Source: Intel Architecture ISA Extensions reference.
sourceNotes.supportedOps: AMX TMUL unit accelerates matrix multiply only. All other ops fall back to the CPU SIMD path (see cpu fallback entry below).
sourceNotes.layoutAgnosticOps: Empty: AMX does not execute elementwise ops. Elementwise ops are handled by the cpu fallback backend.
sourceNotes.costFields: All cost fields absent. AMX throughput is tile-configuration- and problem-size-dependent. Not published as fixed values.
